summary: Scoped trade accounting, safer Chase protection, precise fee administration, and a denser trading workflow.
major: Added trade-scoped live PnL, risk, and fee accounting that stays separate from external Hyperliquid exposure.
Reworked Chase protection around immediate stop growth, proportional take-profit growth, and explicit confirmed coverage.
Added administrator-controlled global, user, and account all-in fee policy with immutable trade snapshots and revenue reporting.
minor: Duplicate Trade now restores the original authored sizing, Chase, protection, and execution settings.
Builder-approval failures now explain the required action and link directly to account authorization.
Added direction-aware stop-loss presets and automatic Hyperliquid price normalization.
Condensed trade economics, risk, fees, creation time, and close actions into denser trade rows.
Added a versioned Patch Notes area with development-only draft previews.
fixes: Fixed the BTC rapid-fill race that compared an older protection query with a newer desired quantity.
Fixed TAO take-profit dust rejection by deferring children below the venue minimum until they become executable.
Fixed protection replacement lineage so a retired predecessor is not reported as unexplained missing coverage.
Fixed Take Over trades remaining in Active after Trad management had been detached.
Fixed fee reports that lost accepted policy snapshots or rejected filtered account pagination.
Fixed trade metric truncation, unnecessary close confirmations, and several builder-remediation contrast failures.

details.title: Trade-scoped economics and risk
items: Compute each managed trade's entry basis from fills allocated to that durable exposure scope instead of borrowing Hyperliquid's one-way net-position cost basis.
Keep externally created same-symbol exposure out of a Trad trade's realized and unrealized PnL.
Show scoped Live PnL beside Realized net on the top-level trade row, using the latest accepted Trad market sample and an explicit unavailable or stale state.
Retain exact per-fill realized PnL and fee evidence inside History and Execution without inventing device-level PnL ownership.
Separate requested Risk budget, accepted Initial planned loss to stop, and Current risk to stop.
Persist the accepted sizing mode, requested risk, decision price, stop, normalized quantity, instrument rules, and fee assumptions needed to reproduce risk after restart.
Keep initial risk immutable while fills, partial closes, and protection amendments update only current remaining risk.
Display actual exchange fees, Trad builder fees, pinned all-in target, and policy source on each managed trade.

details.title: Chase protection controller
items: Grow the full stop immediately whenever accepted entry fills increase managed exposure.
Grow every take-profit child pro rata during partial fills instead of exhausting the first authored tier before starting later tiers.
Coalesce later take-profit-only growth behind a durable 250 ms Hyperliquid timer while keeping stop growth outside that delay.
Flush the final authored take-profit allocations immediately when Chase entry terminates.
Track desired, pending resize, and exchange-confirmed working quantity separately for every protection child.
Carry immutable expected generation and expected terms in each protection write and authoritative query operation.
Treat exact late confirmation of an older generation as succeeded and superseded rather than conflicting with a newer desired target.
Require authoritative successor evidence before retiring the predecessor remote order after a resize.
Stop and cancel remaining Chase entry when confirmed stop coverage has a non-transient controller failure and remains deficient.
Continue recording late fills and continue growing desired stop coverage after entry cancellation so already-acquired exposure is not forgotten.
Keep a deferred or rejected take-profit child independent from healthy stop installation and sibling take profits.
Avoid repeated unchanged inventory and protection events during reconciliation.

details.title: All-in fee policy and revenue
items: Separate Configured all-in target, per-order Trad builder component, and the wallet's builder approval ceiling throughout planning and presentation.
Resolve current policy as account override, then user default, then global default; Stripe plans no longer silently control builder charges.
Keep Hyperliquid's 10 bps perps builder maximum as a read-only venue capability rather than an editable all-in cap.
Derive the submitted builder component as configured all-in target minus the expected maker or taker exchange fee, bounded by venue and wallet approval.
Snapshot policy source, version, target, builder recipient, observed approval ceiling, and exchange-rate evidence on every accepted top-level trade.
Reuse the pinned snapshot for entry slices, Chase reprices, protection, partial closes, and final closes even after an administrator changes current policy.
Avoid double-counting Hyperliquid builder fees when the venue-reported fill fee already includes the builder component.
Add Fees tabs for Overview, Users, Accounts, Active trade policy, Revenue and fees, and Audit.
Add bounded server-side user and account search with owner drilldown and inherit, set, and clear controls.
Report fill-level exchange-only cost, Trad revenue, actual all-in rate, pinned target, source, version, and policy drift.
Retain actor, role, reason, before and after values, policy version, and time for fee-policy mutations.

details.title: Trade workflow and presentation
items: Rename the former per-card Log shortcut to Execution so it accurately opens execution and device evidence.
Remove the Fable-derived Resync totals control because Trad reconciliation is account-wide and does not rebuild one card's totals.
Clarify Take Over as ending Trad management without closing the venue position; taken-over trades become terminal rather than remaining Active.
Restore authored percentage take profits, sizing mode, risk value, Chase timeout, boundary, remainder behavior, execution shape, and trailing settings when duplicating a trade.
Show protection rows as working, resizing to, and desired instead of presenting desired quantity as confirmed exchange coverage.
Add one-click stop presets at 0.5%, 1%, 2%, 5%, and 10% in the direction safer for the selected long or short.
Normalize preset stop prices with the live cached Hyperliquid instrument rules before preview and show the normalized value in the field.
Add an account-authorization call to action when builder approval blocks execution preview.
After guided account setup completes, return first-time users to the new trade ticket instead of opening the legacy command palette.
Reverse the account identity rail's horizontal letter orientation while retaining its configured vertical movement.
Add trade creation timestamps and Active, Closed, and All trade filters.
Remove the redundant confirm-close checkbox from ordinary close-exposure flow.
Repack PnL, risk, and fee metrics into compact paired rows to reduce truncation without making every trade card taller.
Give every published update a stable version URL, copy-link control, crawler-readable metadata, and release-specific social preview image.
Show the running Trad release beside the global brand and link it directly to that version's patch notes.

details.title: Account identity and authorization
items: Reject creation of a new Trad trading account when its canonical exchange wallet and network are already owned by another Trad user.
Preserve existing duplicate historical records non-destructively and quarantine them instead of silently merging financial ownership.
Refresh cross-session account authorization on browser focus, visibility return, and a bounded periodic interval.
Keep already-satisfied agent and builder approval actions idempotent.
Keep ordinary users' fee presentation read-only while administrators control global, user, and account policy.

details.title: Incident repairs
items: Reproduced the client's BTC sequence in which partial Chase fills outran protection resize confirmation and older query evidence locked the trade in reconciliation.
Prevent an older successful query from being compared against a later mutable target quantity.
Link replacement generations so disappearance of the old physical order is explained by an exact active successor.
Never label the desired 15.10574 BTC stop as working when exchange evidence confirms only 0.07372 BTC.
Reproduced the client's TAO sequence in which the middle 370 TP initially produced a 0.026 TAO, $9.62 child below Hyperliquid's $10 minimum.
Classify below-minimum protection as deferred_minimum_notional instead of fatal failed-unprotected state.
Re-plan a deferred TP automatically after cumulative fills make its own trigger-price notional executable.
Consume OwnedExposureDetached in the trader projection so Take Over leaves venue exposure visible but removes the scope from Active Trad management.

details.title: Precision, reporting, and density fixes
items: Normalize Hyperliquid stop and take-profit trigger prices to each live instrument's decimal and significant-figure rules in backend planning.
Use cached instrument metadata in the browser so stop presets do not add a REST request to order entry.
Fix account-filter query parsing that returned HTTP 400 from the Fees account directory.
Correlate fee-report policy snapshots by command ID rather than account ID so current fills no longer appear as legacy or unknown.
Keep cleared leverage and other numeric drafts as text until exact validation so backspacing does not break the settings view.
Replace low-contrast builder-approval remediation with a concise, visible action button and a collapsible technical detail.
Prevent long monetary values and USDC units from being clipped inside dense trade metric columns.
Remove unnecessary confirmation checkboxes from time-sensitive terminal actions while retaining confirmation in destructive settings workflows.

details.title: Qualification included in this patch
items: Replay the exact BTC and TAO production-like event sequences with snapshot and restart boundaries.
Run a 64-case property matrix over late fills and book updates after stop-controller failure.
Verify immediate stop growth and 250 ms take-profit coalescing with deterministic timing tests.
Exercise a protected Market entry, restart, Close Half, protection resize, and Close All on disposable Hyperliquid Mainnet funds.
Exercise a protected risk-sized Chase with three percentage take profits and Duplicate Trade on Hyperliquid Mainnet.
Exercise Take Over while proving the venue position remains open until an independent Flatten.
Walk through every Admin Fees tab against real Mainnet-backed fill evidence.
Keep the test cluster and production untouched during qualification.

summary: The test deployment that replaced the command-first terminal with a complete managed-trade workspace.
major: Rebuilt the terminal around a conventional order ticket and managed trade cards.
Added positions and open-orders views that separate Trad-managed exposure from external Hyperliquid activity.
Added complete settings and administration workspaces for account setup, access, billing, and execution policy.
minor: Added Market, Limit, Chase, and Trailing Entry tabs with fixed-size and risk-based entry workflows.
Added expandable Orders and protection, Chart, Devices, Sequence, and History views on every managed trade.
Added trade duplication, pinning, nickname and color, mini-chart, partial close, protection editing, and takeover actions.
Added guided Hyperliquid agent-slot and builder-authorization setup.
Added responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile navigation and trade layouts.
fixes: Kept the authenticated Gateway connection alive while navigating between terminal and control pages.
Made account deletion, signing-slot replacement, and authorization failures actionable instead of returning generic delivery errors.
Standardized required-field validation and added a searchable market combobox backed by live instrument metadata.
Qualified the workspace on the disposable Hyperliquid Mainnet account before deployment.

details.title: Trade-centric terminal
items: Replace the primary command log with Trades, Positions, Open orders, and Diagnostics product views.
Keep immutable commands as backend authority and diagnostic history while presenting logical managed trades as the trader's primary unit.
Group entry, remaining managed exposure, protection, economics, and close actions into one trade card.
Show venue net position, Trad-owned scopes, and outside-Trad residual separately on one-way Hyperliquid markets.
Link positions and open orders back to the responsible managed trade and scroll/focus the selected card.
Retain the command palette as a redundant expert path rather than the required trading workflow.

details.title: Order ticket and trade controls
items: Provide always-visible Market, Limit, Chase, and Trailing order modes on desktop.
Provide Buy / Long and Sell / Short selection, symbol search, fixed quantity/notional sizing, and risk-at-stop sizing.
Default new entries to stop-market protection and ordinary resting-limit take profits.
Support multiple take-profit rows, percentage or base allocation, stop trigger source, execution shape, Chase timeout, boundary, and remainder behavior.
Add standard and small-test notional presets without hiding exact manual entry.
Add Close All, Close Half, Close Third, Close Quarter, edit protection, cancel remaining entry, and Take Over controls in context.
Open legacy full command forms only for advanced fields not yet represented inline.

details.title: Trade inspection and correlation
items: Add expandable Orders and protection, Chart, Devices, Sequence, and History tabs under a trade.
Rename the relationship DAG from Graph to Sequence so Chart remains reserved for price-over-time data.
Reuse Trailing Entry price charts with activation, peak, jump, stop, take-profit, and decision markers.
Support a compact mini chart beside a collapsed chartable trade.
Open device detail in context without losing the owning trade.
Show commands, generations, fills, protection changes, closes, takeover, and reconciliation chronologically in trade History.
Add right-click and mobile long-press menus for duplicate, pin, nickname/color, chart, devices, sequence, and history.

details.title: Settings and administration
items: Add full-page Profile, Trading accounts, Preferences, and Billing areas using Trad's control-plane design.
Turn account setup into explicit identity, signing connection, and builder-authorization steps with current-step guidance.
Discover the wallet's three Hyperliquid named-agent slots and require explicit replacement when all slots are occupied.
Keep Trad signing keys durable across deletion and recreation of a disposable trading-account record.
Add per-account overview, setup, trading defaults, execution safety, authorization, and danger-zone sections.
Add administrator Operations, Users and access, Account health, Plans and billing, Execution policy, and Audit history areas.
Add super-admin role boundaries so administrators cannot create or demote super administrators.
Add profile display names and selectable/uploaded account imagery.

details.title: Responsive and visual behavior
items: Standardize terminal, settings, and administration under one top-level product header and account menu.
Add a mobile hamburger navigation and separate New trade and Trades tabs without discarding scroll position.
Move the account identity rail to a compact top strip on narrow screens while retaining desktop vertical identity.
Normalize empty states across trades, devices, details, and trading-account lists with one grid-backed pattern.
Add explicit desktop and mobile trade filtering and account selection.
Use account colors as identity accents without reusing them as warning or required-action colors.
Add test/local favicon variants and test-deployment social preview metadata.

details.title: Account and connection durability
items: Move Gateway websocket ownership to the authenticated application session so settings navigation no longer disconnects trading state.
Replace generic account-deletion delivery failures with owner-node reconciliation and actionable retryable errors.
Keep expensive snapshot work outside the account-assignment lock to prevent one-user configuration traffic from starving ownership operations.
Back off repeated identical hydration failure instead of performing unlimited costly recovery loops.
Refresh Hyperliquid named slots after wallet approval so the setup step immediately reflects the replacement.
Prevent already-approved agent or builder controls from remaining dangerously repeatable.
Separate Trad's saved private signing key from the public named slots shown by Hyperliquid.

details.title: Forms and execution semantics
items: Mark invalid required fields at the field with red error treatment and a direct explanation instead of unexplained disabled submission.
Add hover help and required/optional semantics across account and command forms.
Add live market-price freshness beside symbol selection without redundant Live trade and required labels.
Add symbol autocomplete from the live Hyperliquid instrument catalog.
Default Chase entry to post-only maker behavior, take profits to resting limits, and stops to stop-market execution.
Remove adverse-boundary defaulting from Chase Close Exposure.
Preserve managed one-way exposure ownership so reducing one Trad trade does not consume unrelated external exposure.

details.title: Deployment evidence
items: Rehearse Gateway and node startup against disposable clones of the test databases before touching the VPS.
Deploy backend 7675ff5 and frontend a593cf2 to the isolated test cluster on 2026-08-22.
Exercise restart recovery while the client account held a live -0.09157 BTC Mainnet short with exact venue-native stop and take-profit identities.
Restore both configured accounts with ready reconciliation, zero pending effects, and no changed protection identities.
Keep production Trad untouched throughout the rehearsal and deployment.

summary: The first versioned Trad beta terminal and managed-execution foundation.
major: Released the initial Bybit beta terminal for managed order and execution workflows.
minor: Included account selection, command entry, device inspection, charts, and durable execution history.
fixes: Established a tagged frontend baseline for reproducible upgrades and rollback.

details.title: Beta foundation
items: Ship the first tagged frontend release for Bybit managed execution.
Expose command entry, account selection, device inspection, charts, and durable execution history.
Retain trad-beta-0.9.0 as the rollback and comparison baseline for later architecture work.
